people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Archites
people.line: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
translations.bsb: And David’s friend Hushai the Archite went to Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.
